# Three.js (vendored browser modules)

Pinned version: **0.180.0 / r180**, MIT license; see [three.LICENSE](three.LICENSE).
Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180

These browser ES modules are served locally by `export_viewer.py`. They require no
build step or runtime CDN access. `three.module.min.js` imports `three.core.min.js`.
Both files are unmodified upstream builds.
